floorPlans.introduction: Compare the 4-, 5- and 6-bedroom Marèva villas by architectural style. The five-bedroom drawings include versions with and without a basement.
floorPlans.note: The printed totals include the levels, terraces, balconies and carport listed on each original drawing. Where a printed total differs from its component sum, confirm the area on the signed unit drawing.

plans.label: 5 bedrooms · Chamfer
plans.area: 7,965.50 sq ft total area · printed total
plans.areaCalculation: 2900.06 + 2748.88 + 685.45 + 1021.92 + 608.91 = 7965.22 sq ft. Printed total 7965.50 sq ft. Source difference 0.28 sq ft retained.

review.images: Reviewed the seven original images from the official Marèva route. Lagoon panorama leads, the waterside villa is on the card and three interiors are available. Render captions retain the distinction from completed photography.
review.location: Compared the official Marèva pin and The Oasis map with physical brochure page 5. Visually read 18 minutes DWC, 20 Dubai Hills, 28 Dubai Marina and 35 Downtown. The original brochure is shared by the two releases, so estimates are community-level.
review.floorPlans: Matched the original official PDF byte-for-byte and reviewed all 11 physical pages. The cover and all ten residence sheets are marked Marèva, although the URL includes both release names. Whole drawings retain all levels, tables, plans and notices. The 5-bedroom Chamfer without basement prints 7,965.50 sq ft versus 7,965.22 sq ft from the printed components.

unavailable: Villa-specific approach, final orientation, specifications and any layout outside the ten original sheets require unit documentation.
The published 5-bedroom Chamfer without basement total differs from its components by 0.28 sq ft.
